slides.texte_overlay:
Habits that make your 30s
easier than your 20s
Learning to cook ten simple meals. Healthy food stops being a struggle, you save money every week, and you're never stuck ordering takeaway at midnight again.
Building a small emergency fund. Three months of rent set aside turns every bad surprise, a broken car, a lost job, into a problem instead of a crisis.
Training your back and your core. Most men in their 30s start feeling stiff and sore. A strong back now means you'll still move freely in ten years.
Learning to say no without feeling guilty. Your time gets more precious every year. Protect it now and your 30s will feel calm instead of crowded.
Before: I scrolled every evening and felt empty. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I go to bed feeling a little smarter.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I scrolled every evening and felt empty. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I go to bed feeling a little smarter.

slides.texte_overlay: Keeping two or three close friends. Friendships get harder to build after 30. The ones you invest in now will carry you through everything that comes.
Fixing your sleep. A fixed bedtime, a dark room, no phone in bed. Good sleep in your 20s makes your 30s full of energy instead of coffee.
